g.text: Join the external supply ground to Uno GND. Do not route servo motor current through a GPIO or assume the Uno 5 V rail can supply it.

g.desc: Join the external supply ground to Uno GND. Do not route servo motor current through a GPIO or assume the Uno 5 V rail can supply it.

g.text: ERC and exact-net checks verify this logical connection drawing; servo travel and supply behaviour are not physically tested.

g.desc: ERC and exact-net checks verify this logical connection drawing; servo travel and supply behaviour are not physically tested.

g.text: J1 is a logical servo lead order: pin 1=signal, pin 2=V+, pin 3=GND. Uno D9/OC1A supplies only the control signal.

g.desc: J1 is a logical servo lead order: pin 1=signal, pin 2=V+, pin 3=GND. Uno D9/OC1A supplies only the control signal.

g.text: J2 pin 1 is supply +V and pin 2 is supply GND. Choose the supply voltage and current rating from the exact servo documentation.

g.desc: J2 pin 1 is supply +V and pin 2 is supply GND. Choose the supply voltage and current rating from the exact servo documentation.
